dsa.FALCON512: Falcon-512, category 1. Key 896 B, signature about 660 B (variable). The cheapest in gas.
dsa.MLDSA44: ML-DSA (FIPS 204), security category 2. Key 1,312 B, signature 2,420 B.
dsa.MLDSA65: ML-DSA, category 3. Key 1,952 B, signature 3,309 B.
dsa.MLDSA87: ML-DSA, category 5. Key 2,592 B, signature 4,627 B.
dsa.SECP256K1: ECDSA, as on Ethereum. Classical: broken by a quantum computer.
dsa.SECP256K1-FALCON512: Hybrid: an ECDSA and a Falcon-512 signature.
dsa.SECP256K1-MLDSA44: Hybrid: an ECDSA and an ML-DSA-44 signature. Safe as long as either holds.
dsa.SECP256R1: ECDSA on the NIST P-256 curve. Classical.

eval.flows.description: Runs the 19 use-case flows once per signer, each with fresh accounts and contracts, checking the on-chain state of every flow. Reports pass/fail, gas and bytes per flow and algorithm. About 3 minutes.

eval.security.description: Forged and tampered transactions for every algorithm, a simulated quantum adversary that knows every ECDSA private key (against a classical and a hybrid deployment), and known contract flaws. About 3 minutes.
